summary: Loteria Management Web App (Vite Migration) - Comprehensive testing completed. Backend: 10/10 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All main flows verified including Login, Dashboard, Users, Lotteries, Tickets, Results, Statistics pages, and Venta page for sellers.

minor.issue: Takes 3-15 seconds to respond because it scrapes external lottery websites in real-time. This causes the Results page to stay in loading state for a while on initial load.

integration_issues.issue: Shows loading spinner for extended time (3-15s) while waiting for /api/lottery-results/latest. After clicking Actualizar (refresh) button, 21 result cards display correctly with 1st, 2nd, 3rd prizes.

issues: Design looks clean with good contrast and spacing. Dark theme with accent colors is well implemented.

action_items: Consider adding caching or background fetching for /api/lottery-results/latest to improve Results page load time
critical_code_review_comments: Results.jsx useEffect calls loadResults() on mount which hits slow external API - consider showing cached results first or loading indicator with progress message
seed_data_creation: Created seller user vendedor@test.com with password 12345678 for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: App fully migrated to React/Vite from React Native.
